page: Google Cloud Platform n2-highmem-8 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Intel Xeon-based N2 family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with Hyper-Threading enabled, operating at a base clock speed of 2.8 GHz. The processor includes 33 MB of L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 (including VNNI) and AES cryptography. This instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs.

Performance benchmarks position this server primarily in the average tier for multi-core processing and memory operations. The instance achieves average ratings in Passmark CPU and memory tests, alongside average throughput in static web serving and Redis SET operations. However, single-core compute performance and multi-threaded decompression tasks fall into the weaker category. LLM inference speeds are also limited, with poor to weak performance on medium and small models, indicating a lack of optimization for heavy AI workloads.

Given its high memory density relative to compute resources, the n2-highmem-8 offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require substantial memory capacity without demanding extreme CPU performance. This resource profile is well-suited for memory-intensive applications such as medium-sized databases, caching layers, enterprise application servers, and data processing tasks that fit within a 64 GB memory footprint.
